headline: Senior Mobile Application Developer | Flutter & Native Android
summary: Mid-level Mobile Developer with over 5 years of experience in building scalable mobile applications for the Nepal market. Expertise in Flutter, Kotlin, and integration of complex payment gateways like eSewa and Khalti. Proven track record of optimizing app performance and delivering high-quality user experiences in fast-paced startup environments.

experiences.title: Senior Mobile Developer
description: Leading the development of the primary consumer-facing application using Flutter, serving over 100k active monthly users.
Implemented real-time order tracking using Google Maps API and WebSockets, reducing customer support calls by 15%.
Architected a scalable state management solution using BLoC to handle complex cart logic and multi-restaurant ordering.
Mentored junior developers and conducted code reviews to ensure adherence to clean architecture principles.

experiences.title: Mobile Application Developer
description: Developed and maintained core wallet modules using Native Android (Kotlin).
Integrated multiple third-party SDKs for utility bill payments and insurance renewals.
Enhanced application security by implementing biometric authentication and secure key storage.
Collaborated with the backend team to optimize REST API responses, reducing app load time by 20%.

experiences.title: Mobile App Developer
description: Built custom e-commerce and CMS-driven mobile applications for diverse regional clients.
Utilized Firebase Cloud Messaging for targeted push notifications and user engagement tracking.
Worked in an Agile environment with bi-weekly sprints and continuous integration pipelines.

experiences.title: Junior Android Developer
description: Contributed to the development of mobile banking applications for several A-class commercial banks in Nepal.
Focused on UI implementation using XML and Material Design components.
